items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: He was a sweet trumpet player, and still is a sweet trumpet player. His name was John, John something.

ctx.x: Well, the problem I think of, but who else was in the Rhapsodians of that band? Can you remember who else played any of the trumpets and trombones and all of the other...

Many of the members? Uh, Kerry Levine was a saxophone player. He was a sweet saxophone player. Very young. He was about 19 or 20. He was very young. And, uh... We had another one about the name of... I can't recall his name now, but he was a sweet alto also. And... Little Johnny, or Johnny or Little John, he lives uptown now. He's always on the road. He was a sweet trumpet player. Very young stuff. Very young stuff. He was a sweet trumpet player, and still is a sweet trumpet player. His name was John, John…
